request.system:
You are shown the catalogue of an online shop: its name, country and products, with the checked facts we hold about each product. Draft a short store profile that the shop owner will read and correct.

- sells: two or three plain sentences on what the shop sells, by kind of product, as the catalogue shows it.
- audience: one or two sentences on who buys it, only as far as the products themselves show. Do not invent ages, incomes or lifestyles.
- tone: the voice that suits this catalogue for articles: "plain", "friendly" or "expert".

Use only what the catalogue shows. Write in English.

<shop>Tidewell Candles</shop>
<country>US</country>
<products>
- Sea Salt Soy Candle, 8 oz (Candle) — Candles
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle is 8 oz.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle is made of 100% soy wax.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle is poured by hand in Portland, Maine.
    - The Sea Salt Soy Candle has a cotton wick.
- Cedar Wood-Wick Candle, 12 oz (Candle) — Candles
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle is 12 oz.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle is made by Tidewell.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle is made with a coconut and soy wax blend.
    - The Cedar Wood-Wick Candle has a cherry-wood wick that crackles as it burns.
- Beeswax Taper Candles, pair (Taper) — Candles
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles come as a pair.
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles set contains two tapers that are 10 inches long.
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles are made of pure beeswax from Maine apiaries.
    - The Beeswax Taper Candles are unscented.
</products>

content.text: {"sells":"Tidewell Candles sells candles: scented container candles and unscented taper candles. The range includes an 8 oz sea salt soy candle hand-poured in Portland, Maine, a 12 oz cedar candle in a coconut and soy wax blend with a crackling cherry-wood wick, and a pair of 10-inch pure beeswax tapers made with beeswax from Maine apiaries.","audience":"People shopping for home candles who care about the wax and wick, such as soy, coconut-soy or pure beeswax, hand-poured or locally sourced in Maine.","tone":"friendly"}
